evidence.quote: UCD-LLM’s performance depends on the quality of the underlying pre-trained LLM.
Weaknesses in the base model can affect UCD-LLM’s overall results and reliability.
If a debate is triggered, it requires more computation.
Though the debate mechanism adds some computational cost, it helps resolve ambiguities early and reduces the need for later corrections.
Explore more efficient debate mechanisms, optimize logical deduction paths, to reduce the number of LLM calls while ensuring debate quality, in order to reduce time costs.

Explore the integration of more external knowledge based on existing frameworks, such as utilizing relevant knowledge in the field of requirement modeling to establish a knowledge graph, enabling agents to possess more domain knowledge.
